title: Fix PR review feedback for PersistenceManager
description:
Addresses feedback from PR review:

1. Fixed path traversal vulnerability in `export_gitops_artifact` by sanitizing the `label` parameter using `Path(label).name`.
2. Restored `uv` as the dependency manager in GitHub Actions workflows (`.github/workflows/feature-dev.yml` and `.github/workflows/pr-review.yml`), using the `--system` flag to fix the previous `No virtual environment found` crash.
3. Fixed misleading `OSError` exception string in `save_snapshot` (it incorrectly complained about directory creation instead of file writing).
4. Added a warning to prevent silent exception swallowing when timestamp parsing fails in `calculate_trajectory_history`.
